metrics.title: Official unemployment · U-3

metrics.limit: Unemployment insurance receipt is not a requirement

metrics.title: Civilian labor force
metrics.limit: E + U; excludes other nonparticipants

metrics.title: Labor-force participation
metrics.limit: Labor force / civilian noninstitutional population

metrics.limit: Age-specific employment share
